honesty.what: MEASURED at build time by robotics/arena/harness.mjs: policies compared on the AUTHORED, SCHEMATIC robokit world tasks, every declared level, on declared seeds. A sandbox comparison, not a claim about any real robot.
honesty.trained: 1 model trained here: a small behaviour-cloning policy trained on 130 SCRIPTED episodes; not a language model; not trained on any learner's data.
honesty.not_llm: No policy here is a language model, and none calls one. No network.
honesty.data: No learner data is read: the BC network is trained only on SCRIPTED reference episodes generated on the TRAIN seeds; every table run is generated by the harness from declared seeds.
honesty.seats: The 11 sim-seat envs are not run (excluded, with the reason): their SCRIPTED operators live in the 3D page's simulator, which has no headless core.
honesty.wall_time: Wall time per run is measured by `node robotics/arena/harness.mjs --timing` and logged; it is machine-dependent, so it is not stored here and is outside every results_sha256.

scripted.name: Scripted reference
scripted.what: the SCRIPTED reference policy of the robotics lab (potential field to the nearest open goal, reverse after a strike, grip in reach)
scripted.not: not learned, not a model, not a claim about any real robot

random.name: Uniform random
random.what: a uniform-random baseline: every control step draws each action field uniformly from its declared range (seeded per run)
random.not: not learned; a floor every other policy should beat

greedy.name: Greedy pursuit
greedy.what: a SCRIPTED greedy heuristic: turn and drive straight at the nearest open goal, ignore obstacles, back up and turn for 8 steps after a strike
greedy.not: not learned; a simpler hand-written variant of the reference

bc.name: Behaviour cloning (small MLP)
bc.what: a small behaviour-cloning policy trained on 130 SCRIPTED episodes; not a language model; not trained on any learner's data
bc.not: not a language model; not trained on any learner's data
bc.architecture: MLP 24-16-4, softsign hidden units, linear outputs (v, w, grip, vz; masked per task)
bc.trained_by: robotics/arena/train.mjs, in Node at build time
bc.optimiser: plain minibatch gradient descent: learning rate 0.05, batch 64, 24 epochs, no momentum, no Adam
bc.data: 130 SCRIPTED reference episodes (58675 control steps) on the TRAIN seeds 1-10; the TEST seeds 11-20 are held out
bc.inputs: 24 egocentric features: goal bearing and distance, two nearest obstacles and the nearest wall (bearing, clearance), contact, gripper, depth error, v, w, task one-hot
bc.determinism: seeded init (20261012) and shuffles (1018); weights stored as integer micro-units and sha256-pinned
